proposal.reason: Main change is review/merge workflow behavior: reviewer routing, required-approval evaluation, invitation syncing, and squash-preview lifecycle are reworked in .github/scripts/review_automation.py, maintainer_approval.py, commit_message_squash.py, and corresponding .github/workflows/* review/preview pipelines. Other edits (skills/docs/catalog wording and source-sanity hook) support this same contribution/review policy surface rather than introducing an independent runtime module change.
